content_of_post_to_comment: I hate a lot of shit about social media but one recently that I can really notice is that when I try to watch a long form video even if I’m interested in it I just can’t stay focused on it. And I just feel the temptation to check my phone for literally no reason like. Instagram TikTok and speaking to me it’s so hard to resist and it’s driving me crazy. Like just let me live my life ffs.
comment: The weird thing is how the urge to check your phone shows up even when the video is actually interesting. I noticed the same thing after years of short-form content; my brain started expecting a new stimulus every few seconds. Sometimes I have to leave my phone in another room just to retrain that habit. It’s less about discipline and more about breaking the automatic loop.
